answer: Because the grove burn is recorded at the ember settlement, the ripple audit reveals the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. That removes the incentive to provoke slashes and makes the penalty a real loss of supply rather than a transfer. 82% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. A 472 account operation therefore ties up 9 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
